what: An arcane stone altar in a Starfall shrine: stepped plinth, four gold-capped posts and a hovering purple crystal, seen from the isometric camera.

dims.basis: old altar was 1.94u high; plinth spans ~1u (one tile) with a 0.72u depth

views.why: commander camera looks down on the shrine; stepped base and crystal silhouette must read

style_notes: Low-poly diorama, stone #7A7F87, gold #D9A62E, arcane purple #6B3FA0 emissive, no textures. Never: smooth shading, invented hues, stacked boxes without bevels.
notes: Replaces the 388-tri old altar with a stepped/bevelled plinth, tapered pedestal, gold posts and layered crystal shards.
